summary: Repay Holdings Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Credit Agreement for a $500M senior secured first lien term loan facility and a $100M revolving credit facility with Truist Bank as administrative agent. The facilities bear interest at SOFR-based or base rates plus margins ranging from 3.25% to 5.5%. The term loan matures in seven years (or 91 days before the 2029 convertible notes maturity), with quarterly amortization. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
